items.title: 38:44 · Jablonski and Chaplin explain pigmentation as an
items.detail: Jablonski and Chaplin explain pigmentation as an ultraviolet adaptation balancing folate protection and vitamin D synthesis across environments.

items.title: 38:52 · A genome-wide study of 2 092 Africans
items.detail: A genome-wide study of 2,092 Africans found pigmentation variants near four genomic regions, with those regions accounting for roughly twenty-nine percent of measured variation.
